# Command reference

<!-- Generated by `bun run docs` from the Commander tree (packages/cli/src/program.ts) and @imstudium/contract. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every command accepts the global options. With `--json` a command prints exactly one JSON document on stdout (`schemaVersion: "1"` plus the keys below); errors go to stderr as one JSON document with a stable `code` and the process exit code ([ERRORS.md](ERRORS.md)). Keys may be added in a minor release; removing or retyping one is a breaking change.

| Global option | |
|---|---|
| `-V, --version` | output the version number |
| `--json` | JSON output for agents (one document on stdout; errors as JSON on stderr) |
| `--quiet` | Minimal output |
| `--instance <url>` | Stud.IP instance origin (default: digicampus.uni-augsburg.de) |

Shared flags mean the same everywhere: `-o, --output <dir>` is the Studium workspace (or, on `files download` and `--save`, the write destination), `-n, --limit <n>` cuts a list (a positive whole number), `--since <when>` takes `24h`, `7d`, `2w`, `today` or a date, `--course <name>` takes a title fragment, shortcut, slug, number or id.

## Start

### `imstudium onboard`

First-time setup: login, sync workspace, wire agents (idempotent)

```
imstudium onboard [options]
```

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `-o, --output <dir>` | Workspace directory (default: `~/Studium`) |
| `-y, --yes` | Non-interactive |
| `--agents-only` | Skip login/sync — only configure Cursor, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Windsurf, OpenCode |
| `--skip-sync` | Login + agent setup, no file sync |
| `--force` | Re-install skills/MCP even when unchanged |
| `--all-agents` | Configure every harness path, not only detected ones |

### `imstudium init`

Login + sync Studium workspace (use onboard for first-time agent setup)

```
imstudium init [options]
```

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `-o, --output <dir>` | Workspace directory (default: ~/Studium or IMSTUDIUM_WORKSPACE) |
| `-y, --yes` | Non-interactive (skip prompts) |
| `--relogin` | Sign in again even if a session is already stored |
| `--chrome-profile` | Use your Chrome profile with saved passwords (quit Chrome first) |
| `--extract` | Extract new/changed files to markdown and rebuild the search index |

### `imstudium login`

Sign in via browser — opens Stud.IP login every time

```
imstudium login [options]
```

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--oauth` | Use OAuth2 PKCE (requires registered client_id) |
| `--chrome-profile` | Use your Chrome profile with saved passwords (quit Chrome first) |
| `--profile-directory <name>` | Chrome profile folder with --chrome-profile (default: `Default`) |
| `--manual` | Expert fallback: local helper page with manual session paste |
| `--relogin` | Alias for login (browser sign-in always runs) |

### `imstudium logout`

Clear stored session

```
imstudium logout
```

### `imstudium status`

Auth and instance status

```
imstudium status
```

### `imstudium context`

Your study briefing in one call — semester, today, Abgaben, Klausuren, new files, news

```
imstudium context [options]
```

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--live` | Also ask Stud.IP for unread messages |
| `--offline` | Local files only: no Stud.IP calls (semester, live dates, messages) |
| `--since <when>` | How far back 'new' reaches: 24h, 7d, 2w or a date (default: `7d`) |
| `-o, --output <dir>` | Workspace directory (default: ~/Studium or IMSTUDIUM_WORKSPACE) |

**`--json`** — full JSON Schema: `imstudium schema context`

| Key | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `generatedAt` | string | ISO 8601 date-time |
| `semester` | object |  |
| `lastSync` | string \| null |  |
| `today` | object \| null |  |
| `tasks` | object[] |  |
| `exams` | object[] |  |
| `newFiles` | object[] |  |
| `news` | object[] |  |
| `unreadMessages` | integer \| null |  |
| `next` | string[] | Suggested next commands, most useful first |
| `schemaVersion` | "1" |  |

## Today and deadlines

### `imstudium today`

Today's dates across all current courses (cancelled ones marked)

```
imstudium today [options]
```

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--date <day>` | Another day: YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM. or morgen |
| `--offline` | Use the cached calendar.ics instead of Stud.IP |
| `--ics <file>` | Calendar file for --offline (default: &lt;workspace&gt;/calendar.ics) |
| `-o, --output <dir>` | Workspace directory (default: ~/Studium or IMSTUDIUM_WORKSPACE) |

**`--json`** — full JSON Schema: `imstudium schema today`

| Key | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `from` | string | YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/Berlin) |
| `to` | string | YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/Berlin) |
| `source` | "live" \| "ics" |  |
| `stale` | boolean | true when the cached calendar.ics answered instead of Stud.IP |
| `icsUpdatedAt` | string \| null |  |
| `warnings` | string[] |  |
| `days` | object[] |  |
| `date` | string | YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/Berlin) |
| `entries` | object[] |  |
| `next` | object \| null | First date after this day, when the day is empty or over |
| `schemaVersion` | "1" |  |

## What's new

### `imstudium changes`

What arrived from Stud.IP recently (new and updated files)

```
imstudium changes [options]
```

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--since <when>` | 24h, 7d, 2w or a date (default: `7d`) |
| `--course <name>` | Only this course: title fragment, shortcut, slug, number or id |
| `-n, --limit <n>` | Newest N (default all) |
| `-o, --output <dir>` | Workspace directory (default: ~/Studium or IMSTUDIUM_WORKSPACE) |

**`--json`** — full JSON Schema: `imstudium schema changes`

| Key | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `since` | string | ISO 8601 date-time |
| `count` | integer |  |
| `changes` | object[] | Newest first, one entry per path |
| `schemaVersion` | "1" |  |

### `imstudium news`

Announcements: one course, or all current courses merged newest-first

```
imstudium news [course] [options]
```

| Argument | |
|---|---|
| `[course]` | Course title fragment, slug or id (default: all current courses) |

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--course <name>` | Same as the [course] argument |
| `--since <when>` | Only since 24h, 7d, 2w, today or a date like 2026-10-01 |
| `--global` | Stud.IP-wide announcements instead of course news |
| `-n, --limit <n>` | Newest N (default 30) |
| `--save` | Write news/&lt;date&gt;-&lt;title&gt;.md + news/README.md into the course folder(s) |

**`--json`** — full JSON Schema: `imstudium schema news`

| Key | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `scope` | "global" \| "course" \| "courses" |  |
| `courses`? | object[] |  |
| `since` | string \| null | ISO lower bound from --since, null without it |
| `count` | integer |  |
| `news` | object[] |  |
| `saved`? | object[] | With --save: one write report per course |
| `schemaVersion` | "1" |  |

Blubber chats: a course's threads with latest comments, or your stream

```
imstudium blubber [course] [options]
```

| Argument | |
|---|---|
| `[course]` | Course (default: your Blubber stream) |

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--course <name>` | Same as the [course] argument |
| `--thread <id>` | Show the latest comments of one thread |

What happened in your courses: Stud.IP's activity stream, newest first

```

```

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--since <when>` | Since 24h, 7d, 2w, today or a date (default: `7d`) |
| `--type <types>` | documents, news, forum, wiki, message, participants, schedule, courseware (comma-separated) |
| `--course <name>` | Only this course: title fragment, shortcut, slug, number or id |
| `-n, --limit <n>` | Newest N (default 50) |

## Material and courses

### `imstudium search`

Ranked search across slides, scripts, news, forum, courseware and wiki — offline

```
imstudium search <query...> [options]
```

| Argument | |
|---|---|
| `<query...>` | Words to find (umlauts optional: Ubung finds Übung) |

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--course <name>` | Only one course (shortcut, title fragment, slug or folder name) |
| `--kind <kinds>` | Comma-separated: material,news,forum,courseware,wiki,note |
| `--archive` | Also search past semesters (archive/) |
| `-n, --limit <n>` | Results (default 10) |
| `-o, --output <dir>` | Workspace directory (default: ~/Studium or IMSTUDIUM_WORKSPACE) |

**`--json`** — full JSON Schema: `imstudium schema search`

| Key | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `query` | string |  |
| `count` | integer |  |
| `hits` | object[] |  |
| `schemaVersion` | "1" |  |

### `imstudium courseware`

Courseware (Lernmaterial): units, page outline; --save writes markdown + files

```
imstudium courseware [course] [options]
```

Alias: `cw`

| Argument | |
|---|---|
| `[course]` | Course title fragment, slug, number or id (default: all current courses) |

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--course <name>` | Same as the [course] argument |
| `--unit <idOrTitle>` | Only this unit |
| `--save` | Write courseware/&lt;unit&gt;/&lt;NN&gt;-&lt;page&gt;.md and block files into the course folder |
| `-o, --output <dir>` | Course folder for --save (default: the course's workspace folder) |
| `--no-files` | With --save: skip downloading block files |
| `--force` | With --save: rewrite pages even when unchanged |

**`--json`** — full JSON Schema: `imstudium schema courseware`

| Key | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `course` | object |  |
| `units` | object[] |  |
| `tasks` | object[] |  |
| `schemaVersion` | "1" |  |

Shape 2 of 3:

| Key | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `courses` | object[] |  |
| `count` | integer |  |
| `schemaVersion` | "1" |  |

Shape 3 of 3:

| Key | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `courseId` | string |  |
| `courseTitle` | string |  |
| `courseware` | object \| null |  |
| `wiki` | object \| null |  |
| `tasks` | object[] |  |
| `errors` | object[] |  |
| `schemaVersion` | "1" |  |

### `imstudium wiki`

Course wiki: page tree, one page as markdown, or --save into the workspace


| Option | |
|---|---|

| `-o, --output <dir>` | Course folder for --save |
| `--force` | With --save: rewrite unchanged pages |

### `imstudium catalog`

Course catalog for semester planning (Vorlesungsverzeichnis)

```
imstudium catalog <command>
```

#### `imstudium catalog search`

Search a semester's courses by title or number (public, works without login)

```
imstudium catalog search <query...> [options]
```

| Argument | |
|---|---|
| `<query...>` | At least 3 characters |

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--semester <name>` | Semester, e.g. "WS 2026/27" or "all" (default: current) |
| `--area <id>` | Only inside this study area (see catalog areas) |
| `--by <field>` | Search via /courses (login): all, title, lecturer, number, comment |
| `-n, --limit <n>` | Max results (default 15) |
| `--no-details` | Skip lecturers and dates (faster) |

#### `imstudium catalog areas`

Browse study areas (Studienbereiche); --courses lists a subtree's courses

```
imstudium catalog areas [id] [options]
```

| Argument | |
|---|---|
| `[id]` | Study area id (default: top level) |

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--courses` | List the area's courses for the semester |
| `--semester <name>` | Semester for --courses (default: current) |
| `-n, --limit <n>` | Max courses (default 40) |

#### `imstudium catalog modules`

Modules (MVV) by name or code — needs login

```
imstudium catalog modules [query...] [options]
```

| Argument | |
|---|---|
| `[query...]` | Name or module code, at least 3 characters |

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--semester <name>` | Only modules valid in this semester (default: current; "all" for any) |
| `-n, --limit <n>` | Max results (default 30) |

#### `imstudium catalog studies`

Courses of study (Studiengänge) — needs login

```
imstudium catalog studies [query...] [options]
```

| Argument | |
|---|---|
| `[query...]` | Name, at least 3 characters |

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `-n, --limit <n>` | Max results (default 30) |

#### `imstudium arbeit new`

Start an Arbeit: its folder, an empty citation registry, quellen.bib and ARBEIT.md

```
imstudium arbeit new <title...> [options]
```

|---|---|

| `--sprache <lang>` | Language of the work, e.g. de-DE or en-US (default: the style's, else de-DE) |
| `--betreuung <name>` | Supervisor (stays in your workspace) |
| `--slug <slug>` | Folder name under arbeiten/ (default from the title) |
| `--dir <folder>` | Create the Arbeit in this folder instead (e.g. your LaTeX or Typst project) |
| `-o, --output <dir>` | Workspace directory (default: ~/Studium or IMSTUDIUM_WORKSPACE) |

#### `imstudium stile add`

```
imstudium stile add <style> [options]
```

| Argument | |
|---|---|
| `<style>` | Style id (stile find), a zotero.org/styles URL, or a .csl file |

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--no-use` | Only add it, keep the current style |
| `--arbeit <name>` | Which Arbeit: slug, title fragment or folder (default: the folder you are in, then the one picked with arbeit use) |
| `-o, --output <dir>` | Workspace directory (default: ~/Studium or IMSTUDIUM_WORKSPACE) |

## Workspace and sync

### `imstudium semester`

Where you are in the semester; start a new one (archive the last, sync the new)

```
imstudium semester <command> [options]
```

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `-o, --output <dir>` | Workspace directory (default: ~/Studium or IMSTUDIUM_WORKSPACE) |

**`--json`** — full JSON Schema: `imstudium schema semester`

| Key | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `current` | object \| null | The semester running now per Stud.IP; null offline |
| `workspace` | object \| null |  |
| `archive` | object[] |  |
| `needsRollover` | boolean |  |
| `next` | string |  |
| `schemaVersion` | "1" |  |

#### `imstudium semester start`

Archive the previous semester folder and sync the new semester

```
imstudium semester start [options]
```

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `-o, --output <dir>` | Workspace directory (default: ~/Studium or IMSTUDIUM_WORKSPACE) |
| `--semester <label>` | Target semester (default: the one running now) |
| `--extract` | Extract materials and build the search index after syncing |
| `--dry-run` | Show what would move and download |

**`--json`** — full JSON Schema: `imstudium schema semester start`

Shape 1 of 2:

| Key | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `semester` | object |  |
| `rollover` | object |  |
| `report` | object |  |
| `extracted` | integer |  |
| `schemaVersion` | "1" |  |

Shape 2 of 2:

| Key | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `semester` | object |  |
| `plan` | object |  |
| `downloads` | integer |  |
| `schemaVersion` | "1" |  |

### `imstudium sync`

Sync files and rebuild the Studium workspace (current semester by default)

```
imstudium sync [options]
```

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `-o, --output <dir>` | Workspace directory (default: ~/Studium or IMSTUDIUM_WORKSPACE) |
| `--course <name>` | Sync a single course |
| `--semester <label>` | Semester title or slug (e.g. SS2026, WS2025-26) |
| `--all-semesters` | Every enrolled semester: current at the root, the rest under archive/ |
| `--layout <mode>` | tree (mirror Stud.IP folders) or flat (default: `tree`) |
| `--dry-run` | List changes without downloading |
| `--include <items>` | Comma-separated: calendar,wiki,news,forum,courseware,tasks (default: all) |
| `--extract` | Extract new/changed files to markdown and rebuild the search index |

**`--json`** — full JSON Schema: `imstudium schema sync`

| Key | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `downloaded` | integer |  |
| `skipped` | integer |  |
| `failed` | integer |  |
| `bytes` | number |  |
| `errors` | object[] |  |
| `courseErrors`? | object[] |  |
| `semesters` | object[] |  |
| `changes` | object[] |  |
| `extracted`? | integer | Only with --extract |
| `schemaVersion` | "1" |  |

### `imstudium extract`

Local ingest: pdf-inspector (PDF) + AnyDoc (Office) → content.md; photos copied to pages/

```
imstudium extract [options]
```

Alias: `ingest`

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--course <name>` | Only one course (title fragment, shortcut, slug or id) |
| `--file <path>` | Extract a single file to &lt;file&gt;-extracted/ |
| `--no-images` | Don't copy photos into pages/ |
| `--force` | Re-extract even if unchanged |
| `-o, --output <dir>` | Workspace directory (default: ~/Studium or IMSTUDIUM_WORKSPACE) |

### `imstudium index`

Build/rebuild page index (corpus.jsonl) — for agent grep / semantic search, not a custom search engine

```
imstudium index [options]
```

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--course <name>` | Only one course |
| `-o, --output <dir>` | Workspace directory (default: ~/Studium or IMSTUDIUM_WORKSPACE) |

### `imstudium view`

Build viewer.html for slide PNGs — fast path for Playwright / browser agents

```
imstudium view [options]
```

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--dir <path>` | Already-extracted directory (contains pages/) |
| `--course <name>` | Course (title fragment, shortcut, slug or id) |
| `--file <name>` | Material filename substring |
| `-o, --output <dir>` | Workspace directory (default: ~/Studium or IMSTUDIUM_WORKSPACE) |

### `imstudium watch`

Continuous sync loop (--json: one JSON line per round)

```
imstudium watch [options]
```

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--interval <duration>` | Pause between rounds: 30m, 1h, 6h (at least 5m) (default: `1h`) |
| `-o, --output <dir>` | Workspace directory (default: ~/Studium or IMSTUDIUM_WORKSPACE) |

### `imstudium export`

Export Stud.IP data as files (calendar.ics)

```
imstudium export <command>
```

#### `imstudium export calendar`

Write your Stud.IP calendar as calendar.ics into the workspace

```
imstudium export calendar [options]
```

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `-o, --output <dir>` | Directory for calendar.ics (default: the workspace) |

## Stud.IP API and contracts

### `imstudium routes`

Every JSON:API route this Stud.IP offers (cached from /discovery)

```
imstudium routes [query] [options]
```

| Argument | |
|---|---|
| `[query]` | Filter by substring, e.g. forum, courseware, users |

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--method <method>` | Only routes with this HTTP method (default: `GET`) |
| `--all-methods` | Include POST/PATCH/DELETE routes |
| `--refresh` | Fetch the catalog again |

### `imstudium api`

Call any Stud.IP JSON:API route — the escape hatch for agents

```
imstudium api <path> [options]
```

| Argument | |
|---|---|
| `<path>` | Route path, e.g. /users/me/courses or /courses/&lt;id&gt;/forum-categories |

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `-i, --include <rels>` | JSON:API include, comma-separated |
| `-f, --filter <key=value>` | filter[key]=value (repeatable) |
| `--fields <type=a,b>` | Sparse fieldset (repeatable) |
| `-p, --param <key=value>` | Raw query parameter (repeatable) |
| `-n, --limit <n>` | Page size / max items |
| `--all` | Follow pagination to the end |
| `--flat` | Flatten resources: attributes up front, relationships as ids |
| `-X, --method <method>` | HTTP method (non-GET needs --write) (default: `GET`) |
| `-d, --data <json>` | Request body for POST/PATCH |
| `--write` | Allow a request that changes data in Stud.IP |

### `imstudium schema`

JSON Schema of a command's --json output (from @imstudium/contract)

```
imstudium schema [command...]
```

| Argument | |
|---|---|
| `[command...]` | Command path, e.g. today, "semester start", error or feed.FeedItem |

## Setup and health

### `imstudium setup`

Idempotent agent wiring (skills, MCP) — only updates what changed

```
imstudium setup <command>
```

#### `imstudium setup status`

Show detected agents and setup manifest

```
imstudium setup status
```

#### `imstudium setup skills`

Install or refresh the bundled agent skills

```
imstudium setup skills [options]
```

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--agent <agent>` | cursor \| claude-code \| claude-desktop \| codex \| windsurf \| opencode \| all |
| `--all-agents` | Configure every harness, not only detected |
| `--force` | Overwrite unchanged skills |
| `-y, --yes` | Non-interactive |

#### `imstudium setup workflows`

Install or refresh agent workflows / slash commands

```
imstudium setup workflows [options]
```

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--agent <agent>` | cursor \| claude-code \| claude-desktop \| codex \| windsurf \| opencode \| all |
| `--all-agents` | Configure every harness, not only detected |
| `--force` | Overwrite unchanged workflows |

#### `imstudium setup mcp`

Register the imstudium MCP server with your agents (opt-in)

```
imstudium setup mcp [options]
```

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--agent <agent>` | cursor \| claude-code \| claude-desktop \| codex \| windsurf \| opencode \| all |
| `--all-agents` | Configure every harness, not only detected |
| `--force` | Rewrite MCP config even if identical |
| `-o, --output <dir>` | Studium workspace path (default: config / IMSTUDIUM_WORKSPACE) |

#### `imstudium setup migrate`

Migrate DigiCampus config/skills/MCP to ImStudium (idempotent)

```
imstudium setup migrate [options]
```

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--all-agents` | Configure every harness, not only detected |
| `-y, --yes` | Non-interactive |
| `-o, --output <dir>` | Studium workspace path (default: config / IMSTUDIUM_WORKSPACE) |

#### `imstudium setup all`

Skills + workflows (idempotent — skips unchanged). MCP is opt-in: setup mcp

```
imstudium setup all [options]
```

| Option | |
|---|---|
| `--agent <agent>` | cursor \| claude-code \| claude-desktop \| codex \| windsurf \| opencode \| all |
| `--all-agents` | Configure every harness, not only detected |
| `--force` | Overwrite even when unchanged |
| `-y, --yes` | Non-interactive |
| `-o, --output <dir>` | Studium workspace path (default: config / IMSTUDIUM_WORKSPACE) |

### `imstudium config`

Show or change ~/.config/imstudium/config.json

```
imstudium config <command>
```

#### `imstudium config show`

Effective configuration (file + environment + flags)

```
imstudium config show
```

#### `imstudium config set`

Set a key: base-url | workspace

```
imstudium config set <key> <value>
```

| Argument | |
|---|---|
| `<key>` |  |
| `<value>` |  |

### `imstudium session`

Session management: import a Stud.IP session cookie

```
imstudium session <command>
```

Store a Seminar_Session cookie (from --cookie or a Netscape cookie file)

### `imstudium doctor`

Check install, session, workspace, ingest engines, agent setup and the MCP door — each with a fix

```
imstudium doctor [options]
```

| Option | |

| `-o, --output <dir>` | Workspace directory (default: ~/Studium or IMSTUDIUM_WORKSPACE) |

**`--json`** — full JSON Schema: `imstudium schema doctor`

| Key | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `ok` | boolean | No check failed |
| `offline` | boolean |  |
| `versions` | object |  |
| `summary` | object |  |
| `checks` | object[] |  |
| `schemaVersion` | "1" |  |

### `imstudium update`

Upgrade CLI (if needed) and refresh agent skills/MCP

```

```
